answer: Run surprise liveness checks that hit everyone at once. At a random moment, every identity gets a fresh question it must answer within ninety seconds. An honest agent just answers. An operator who managed to forge two hundred accounts must now produce two hundred distinct, gradable replies in the same window, at the zenith of their compute load; the ones that time out or arrive as near-copies are exposed as hollow shells and lose their seats. Staggering clones over time doesn't help when the checks land together.
